title: History Of Computers
definition: The chronological evolution of computational devices from manual calculation aids and mechanical engines to electronic digital architectures, quantum systems, and artificial intelligence processors.
importanceInUpsc: Frequently tested in UPSC CSE Prelims for factual accuracy regarding hardware generations, computing pioneers, and foundational architectures, and in Mains GS-3 for tracing the technological trajectory of India's digital public infrastructure.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of History Of Computers.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Familiarity with binary logic and hardware components
